description.narrative:
Syftet med insatsen är följande: (i) stödja utvecklingen av gröna, sociala och hållbara lån på den afrikanska kontinenten; (ii) utveckla verktyg och metoder för att bedöma och stödja afrikanska banker; och (iii) tillhandahålla teknisk assistans (TA) till banker för att säkerställa efterlevnad av globala standarder för gröna, sociala och hållbara lån.
Insatsen implementeras genom en plattform som är anpassad för att utvärdera bankers behov av TA-stöd gällande grön, social och hållbar utlåning. GTM plattformen är utvecklad så att den kan komma in och genomföra en initial bedömning av bankens behov och planera ett TA-stöd. Därefter tar TA-komponenterna över. TA-stödet är tillgängligt till banker där Sida har pågående garantier eller för samtal med för utvecklingen av nya garantier. TA-stödet till bankerna bekostas genom Sidas strategier, medfinansierade av bankerna själva och potentiella andra givare. GTM kan även arbeta med andra finansiella institutioner som är i behov av TA-stöd.

The main objectives of the contribution are: (i) support the development of green, social, and sustainable lending across Africa; (ii) develop tools and methods for assessing and supporting African banks; (iii) provide technical assistance (TA) to banks to ensure adherence to global green, social and sustainable loan standards.

The overall goal of the project is to enhance resilience and sustainability in key economic sectors of target countries by promoting green loans and the objective is to increase the green loans portfolio of commercial banks and financial institutions in Africa. The overall objective will be realized through enlisting various banks across Africa to be part of the program; assessing the needs of the banks and financial institutions to develop a tailor-made green lending technical assistance facility; and providing the appropriate green lending technical assistance to selected banks or financial institutions.

title.narrative: Grant agreement between Sida and GGGI

description.narrative:
Sida and GGGI mutually agreed to transition the GTM activities towards the broader and more strategic initiative, Leveraging Investment and Finance for a Green Transition (LIFT). GTM has been integrated as a key component of LIFT to build a more streamlined Theory of Change and stronger alignment with Sidas focus on mobilization of climate finance. From the one year period,of implementation (July 2024 July 2025), the results achieved are at the output/activity level. Therefore, these activities have formed a foundation for implementation of component three activities under LIFT and provision of relevant support to country windows. Therefore, the outcomes and impact of the GTM contribution will be highlighted within the LIFT contribution.
Below are the results at output level within the period under review:
- GGGI developed the green lending toolkit during the inception period. The toolkit was tested and used to conduct a gap assessment on green lending on Zimbabwe Agricultural Development Trust (ZADT). while the initial toolkit was developed for financial institutions , GGGI customised the toolkit to fit ZADT's mandate as a financial ecosystem actor.
- GGGI continued to develop a standard green lending toolbox to define, supervise, monitor and report the impact and performance of the TA support. In addition, once the Green Lending Toolkit is finalized, GGGI will design and deliver a comprehensive training program specifically for Sida staff.
- During the GTM project period, Regional Team Environment (RTE) identified financial institutions already engaged under existing guarantees schemes such as KCB Bank Kenya, Equity BCDC, and I&M Rwanda. Partners identified under the guarantee pipeline included NCBA, I&M Kenya, CRDB Bank Tanzania, Equity Tanzania, DFCU Bank Uganda, and Ecobank. However, during this period there were no guarantees materialised making the linkage to GTM difficult.
These activities/ engagements have formed a solid ground for the LIFT component 3.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
